description: A Perl script for downloading files with support for multiple mirrors, checksum verification, and different download tools (curl, wget, aria2c). It manages mirror lists, handles local and remote sources, and ensures file integrity.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and configuration, returns a list of mirror URLs.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Reads project-specific mirror URLs from a JSON file and appends them to the mirrors list.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a program is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command (md5 or sha256) based on the length of the provided hash.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a specific download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) is available and matches expected version output.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the download tool to use based on environment variables and availability.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command line for downloading files using the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download from a mirror, verifies checksum, and manages temporary files.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary download and hash files.
